titulo: Inside Google: where the money comes from and why it's winning AI 🔍 #shorts
descripcion:
Inside the Magnificent 7, episode 1: Google (Alphabet). Data from the Q3 2026 earnings release (Jul–Sep) and the LMArena leaderboard. Educational, not investment advice.

💵 Quarterly revenue: $127.6B (+25%)
• Search: $63.4B · Cloud: $30.7B (+103%) · Subscriptions, Play & devices: $14.3B · YouTube ads: $11.2B · Ad network: $7.5B
☁️ Google Cloud operating income: $11.1B
🏗️ Quarterly capex: $51.4B
🧪 Other Bets (incl. Waymo): $2.04B loss
🏆 LMArena text (Nov 18, 2026): 1) Gemini 4 Carbon 1526 · 2) Gemini 4 Argon 1521 · 3) Gemini 4 Neon 1518 · 4) Muse Wonder (Meta) 1511 · 5) Claude Opus 5.5 1507

escenas.texto: Google sold one hundred twenty seven point six billion dollars in three months. Where does all that money come from, and is it winning the A I race?
Almost half comes from search: sixty three billion in ads. Then the cloud, with thirty one billion; subscriptions, the Play Store and phones, fourteen; and YouTube ads, eleven.

visual.pre: where the money comes from (3 months)

escenas.texto: And the fastest grower is the cloud: Google Cloud doubled its sales in a year. It rents A I computing to other companies, and already earns eleven billion a quarter.
Its secret weapon is its own A I chips, called TPUs. Google designs them to depend less on Nvidia, and now it sells them to other companies too.

Its lab, DeepMind, builds the Gemini models. And on LMArena, the ranking where people vote blind between two A I models, with over nine million votes, the top three spots right now all belong to Gemini.
To keep all that going, it spends like few others: fifty one billion dollars in a single quarter, mostly on data centers.
The risk? That A I eats its search business. So far the opposite is happening: searches are growing at the fastest pace in five years. And its other bets, like Waymo, lost two billion in the quarter.
This is educational, not investment advice. Next magnificent: Microsoft. Comment which one you want after that.
